description.zh: 专精 wb-character 工作台 · 角色概念设计 / 怪物档案 / NPC 设定 / 载具外观。从一行 idea + Iori 的玩法柱 + Kotone 的角色 bio 出发,产出 portrait + turnaround + character.manifest.json。只管静态视觉与档案,不画动画(交给动画设计师)、不做 VFX(交给特效设计师)。
description.en: Specializes in the wb-character workbench — character concept design, monster dossiers, NPC profiles, vehicle silhouettes. Takes one-line ideas plus Iori's pillars and Kotone's bios; outputs portrait + turnaround + character.manifest.json. Static visuals and profiles only — animation goes to the Animator, VFX to the VFX Artist.
